home.whySubtitle: The things that actually matter when you are on holiday.
home.why1Text: To your hotel, Djerba-Zarzis International Airport or your rental: we deliver anywhere on Djerba Island, every day between 08:00 and 20:00, for {fee}.
home.why2Text: The daily rate includes the helmet and all equipment; delivery ({fee}) is shown separately. Nothing is added when you hand the scooter back.
home.why3Text: Our scooters are regularly serviced. If anything goes wrong we intervene immediately, anywhere on the island.
home.why4Text: One WhatsApp message is enough. No online payment: you pay cash on delivery, in euro, dollar or dinar.
home.howSubtitle: Three steps and you are riding.

home.intro: Locascoot Djerba rents scooters across the whole island of Djerba. Whether you are staying in Houmt Souk, Midoun, the Tourist Zone or Aghir, or arriving at Djerba-Zarzis International Airport, we deliver your scooter to the address of your choice on the island, every day between 08:00 and 20:00, for {fee}. A helmet and full equipment come with every rental, and we intervene immediately in case of a breakdown.

prices.depositText: A deposit is taken when the vehicle is handed over and returned in full when you bring it back in the condition you received it. The amount depends on the model and is shown in the table above.
